title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: After the final whistle
hook: What happens in the five minutes after your games?
intro: Kids rush to their parents before the handshake line.
statement: How a game ends is part of the game.
q1: Do you hold a short team talk before kids leave —
q2: or let them go and talk at the next practice?
q3: What do you want them to carry home?
t1: There is no single right way. But games end well
t2: when there is a moment to close them together.
cta: Coaches — how do you end games?
ctaLines: Handshakes. A two-minute talk. A team cheer.
ctaPrompt: Share your post-game habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What happens in the five minutes after your games?
The game ends. Kids rush to their parents before the handshake line.
How a game ends is part of the game.
Talk right after or at the next practice. Every team is different.
How do you end games? Share your habit in the comments.
